Note::is_upper¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::is_upper() const

Test Whether A Cell Is Upper-Case¶

is_upper() reports, for each cell, whether it contains at least one cased letter and none of them are lower-case. Digits, spaces, and punctuation are ignored; a cell with no letters ("123", "") fails.

Case is judged on ASCII letters. A non-ASCII letter is treated as uncased.

Return value¶

A Bool Note with the receiver’s shape, one native truth value per cell. Use bools() for a borrowed contiguous host view.

Example 1: A Batch¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note(
    {"ABC", "abc", "Abc", "ABC123", "A B", "123", ""});
const auto mask = n.is_upper();
std::cout << "[";
for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mask.bools().size(); ++i)
  std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << static_cast<int>(mask.bools()[i]);
std::cout << "]\n";

Output¶

[1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0]

"ABC123" and "A B" pass (the digit and space are ignored); "123" and "" have no cased letter.
